description: E Bike Ladestationen - Rhein-Kreis Neuss is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.rhein-kreis-neuss.de. The data set contains the locations of the E Bike charging stations from the culture and leisure guide in the Rhein-Kreis Neuss. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "E Bike charging stations - Rhein-Kreis Neuss" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Infrastruktur, Ladestation, Grevenbroich, Kaarst, Akku, E Bike. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
